description: This is an HTML file containing embedded JavaScript code that demonstrates drag-and-drop widget behaviors using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It includes definitions for draggable canvases with various appearances and interactions, as well as HTML UI elements to control the behaviors.

methods.name: setIntersectStyles
methods.description: Toggles between 'rect' and 'mouse' drag intersect styles for multiple drag-related canvases based on checkbox input.

methods.name: initializeForm
methods.description: Initializes the HTML form elements when the page loads.
